text:
Josh Doan's second season in Buffalo has been quieter on the scoresheet: 8 points in 25 games at about 15 minutes a night. The chances are there. He has 5.88 expected goals, our measure of chance quality, against four actual goals, and his 0.94 expected goals per 60 is a real shooter's rate. One headline from Buffalo Hockey Beat sums up where he is: "Sabres' Josh Doan no longer cheating for offense, says game 'in a good spot'."

That trade shows up in the details. On Wednesday against the Rangers he started a rush and fed Josh Norris on a two-on-one for the third line's goal, the kind of play three reporters noted in real time. NHL EDGE has him among the fastest skaters in the league, 70 bursts over 20 mph (94th percentile). Evolving-Hockey liked him a lot last season: 2.2 wins above replacement, 42nd of 401 forwards, with his team creating 0.27 more expected goals per 60 when he was on (97th percentile). At five on five this season the Sabres have had 45.2% of the expected goals with him out there. Our numbers project 18 goals.
headline: Josh Doan, quietly doing the right things
